overview: PowerAmp Player is a browser-based touchscreen virtual music player and advanced audio control system with a CarPlay-style grid interface. Features a Master Commander Unit, 4 fully isolated audio channels (Bass, Mids, Highs, Tweeters), 26+ feature tiles all truly wired to the audio chain, and a smart diagnostic system.
features: Master Commander Unit with live diagnostics and 1000-item history
4 fully isolated audio channels — Bass (14-50Hz), Mids, Highs, Tweeters
Audio locked to app page only — chat page banned from any audio access
26+ feature tiles each with own dedicated audio nodes
True 12-layer power chain with Signal Booster, System Booster, Virtual Power Converter
New Protection System with 3 sliders — Distortion Clean, Clipping Control, Particle Breakdown
99.0 Scanner — full diagnostic tool with auto-fix
